title: Terraform VPC blueprint module: egress mappings, endpoint health probes, and upgrade sentinel
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that defines a VPC blueprint optimized for Redwood Private deployments. The module will manage subnet topology (public/private/isolated), egress configuration (NAT gateways + optional egress proxy support), VPC endpoints (S3, KMS, ECR, Secrets Manager), route tables, and automated endpoint health probes. Add an 'upgrade sentinel' pattern so higher-level automation can detect in-place vs destructive changes and orchestrate safe upgrades. The module should support multi-az deployments and allow customers to opt into NAT-less (IGW-only) or centralized egress proxy architectures.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes inputs for AZ count, subnet CIDR chunks, nat configuration (single/ha/none), and endpoint list
Module creates route tables and explicit routes for each subnet type and verifies route propagation
Endpoint health probes created as optional AWS Lambda + CloudWatch synthetic checks with configurable thresholds
Upgrade sentinel resource emits a stable hash of critical inputs and module-managed mutable resources to detect incompatible changes
Module supports optional egress-proxy integration (env var + security groups + route overrides) and documents steps for on-prem egress appliances
Automated terraform plan guard prevents accidental replacement of NAT gateways without explicit 'force_replace' flag
Unit/integration tests for Terraform using localstack and terratest run in CI and pass
Docs and quickstart examples added to repo; migration guide for existing Private deployments included
tasks: Design module input/output schema and defaults
Implement subnet & route table resources with per-AZ mapping
Implement NAT/IGW selection and HA options
Implement VPC endpoint creation with policy attachment hooks
Build health probe framework: Lambda, CloudWatch alarms, SNS topic, remediation webhook
Implement upgrade sentinel (stable checksum resource) and terraform plan guard logic
Add egress-proxy integration and example overlay configuration
Create docs, migration guide, and example usage in private-deploy playground
Open PR and run cross-team review with Security and Infra
design_decisions: Use explicit route tables per subnet type instead of relying on default route table to reduce accidental route leakage
Prefer NAT Gateway for simplicity but support centralized egress proxy for cost-sensitive customers
Upgrade sentinel will be a custom null_resource with triggers = [sha256(concat(...))] to surface drift/change in plan
Health probes implemented as Lambda synthetic checks to allow TCP, HTTPS, and DNS validation against VPC endpoints
Use tags and resource naming consistent with Redwood Private naming convention for easier cross-account toolability
implementation_notes: Module will be written in Terraform 1.5+ and use the aws provider pinned to >= 5.0
Prefer data.aws_availability_zones to map AZs dynamically but allow explicit azs input for reproducible topologies
Plan guard implemented via CI job that scans terraform plan output for resource replacements of aws_nat_gateway or aws_vpn_gateway and fails unless TF_VAR_force_replace=true
Keep Lambda code in /modules/vpc/health_probe_lambda to allow packaging during release pipeline
Expose outputs: vpc_id, subnet_ids_by_type, nat_gateway_ids, endpoint_ids, upgrade_sentinel_hash
test_plan: Unit: terraform validate + fmt + tflint in CI
Integration: terratest spinning up minimal topology in ephemeral account or localstack (S3 + KMS endpoints)
Health probe smoke test: create endpoint + run lambda check and assert CloudWatch alarm OK
Upgrade test: modify critical input (e.g., change nat_mode from 'ha' to 'single') and assert plan shows sentinel change and CI gate blocks unless override
Chaos test: simulate endpoint failure and verify CloudWatch alarm triggers and remediation webhook fires
rollout_plan: Stage 1: merge module to internal modules repo behind feature flag
Stage 2: run in staging Private deployments with canary customers (internal infra team) for 2 weeks
Stage 3: open beta for newly provisioned Private customers with opt-in toggle
Stage 4: promote to stable and roll out migration docs for existing customers
Rollback: provide explicit 'force_replace' and manual NAT migration playbook; preserve previous module version tag
